title: Unified Priority Queue
description: Tools awaiting recipe generation, each with a pre-resolved source. Mirrors batch.UnifiedQueue and batch.QueueEntry in internal/batch/queue_entry.go.

name.description: Tool name, used as the recipe name (e.g., ripgrep)

source.description: Pre-resolved source in ecosystem:identifier format (e.g., homebrew:ripgrep, github:sharkdp/bat)

status.description: Queue processing state. excluded is permanent until edited by hand.

confidence.description: How the source was selected: by the disambiguation algorithm, or by hand

disambiguated_at.description: When disambiguation last ran for this entry; null if never

next_retry_at.description: Earliest retry time under backoff; null if no backoff is active
